svg.title: Installs
svg.desc: Installs of jdx's tools through mise in the 30 days to Oct 4, CI excluded: mr boxington 3,361 (new), hk 60,274 (48% month over month), pitchfork 14,682 (20% month over month), fnox 42,829 (15% month over month), usage 52,226 (-2% month over month), aube 11,739 (-9% month over month). jdx tools combined 18% month over month, all of mise 14%.

g.text: installs through mise · 30d to Oct 4 · CI excluded
jdx tools +18% · all of mise +14% MoM
